title: Incremental Shadow Scan and Hotfix Rollback Playbook
creator: Asha Narayan
description: Problem statement: Recent releases occasionally surface low-frequency regression patterns only visible under specific sequence-length distributions or mixed RLHF chat workloads. Existing canary and smoke suites catch many failures but miss subtle throughput regressions or cache-priming regressions that only appear after 30+ minutes under a realistic prefix distribution. We need an incremental shadow scan that: 1) mirrors a fraction of production traffic to the candidate without affecting end users; 2) runs targeted synthetic evals (embedding drift, reranking accuracy, generation token-level latency) in parallel; 3) aggregates multi-signal gating with weighted quorum to decide auto-rollback or require human review.
comments: 2026-03-02 - Initial spike: validated feasibility of request duplication in the router layer; minimal latency impact measured (~0.5ms p50) when duplicating 2% of traffic to a shadow endpoint.

2026-03-04 - Architecture sync: decided to run shadow scans as ephemeral jobs in the dedicated pool to avoid noisy neighbor effects in hosted API tests; will annotate incoming requests with X-Shadow-Run header for traceability.

2026-03-06 - Trade-off discussion: we can increase fidelity by duplicating full payloads but that increases cost; agreement to prioritize header-only routing + sampled payload replay for heavy workloads (batching, embeddings).
2026-03-08 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pulls/1948 - shadow-proxy-routing + trace propagation. Tagging reviewers: @julia-chen, @omar-singh.

2026-03-10 - Pilot runs: 8h pilot across eu-west-1 with 1% traffic; detected a 7% p95 token-latency increase for model-variant v2-quant-a under sequence lengths >2048. Signal surfaced in perf-gates aggregator; alert routed to oncall.
2026-03-10 - Next: implement automatic waterline calculation (baseline delta threshold) and correlate with eval-suite scorecards before auto-rollback decision is exposed to SRE/PM.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow-scan can be enabled per-release with a single flag and sample rate (0.01..0.1).
Perf aggregator produces time-windowed deltas (p50/p90/p95) and compares to baseline for sequence-length cohorts.
Eval suite runs (functional + rerank + embeddings) are executed automatically during the shadow window and results are correlated with runtime metrics.
A weighted-quorum decision engine emits one of: NO_ACTION, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, AUTO_ROLLBACK. Logic and thresholds documented in the playbook.
Rollback playbook includes runbook steps, required approvals, and a hotfix pressure-test checklist for rapid patch-and-release cycles.
Dashboard tile, alerting rule, and postmortem template available in Console for any shadow-scan-triggered rollback/human-review events.
blockers: A/B router does not yet propagate full trace headers to dedicated pools in us-east-1 (ENG-602317 opened).
Need approval for transient cost budget increase for pilot shadow duplication (Finance signoff).
